zitat: Base it on the speech profile and the quotes if there are any, otherwise on the description.

vorschlag: Pass the group's own chat sentences about each character into this user part as 'Way of speaking (said by the group): ...' and let the model only fill characters about which the group said nothing. Otherwise the bot invents Samir's way of speaking one turn after the group defined it.

regel: 09-gespraech-phase7 line 636: "You: Then scene 3 is a chorus. I have the forms for all three." and system line 12 "number, title, form and the full text"
vorschlag: Build the form label per scene from the saved forms (scene 3 = chor), not a hard-coded 'dialog'. Otherwise the final check judges the chorus as if it were a dialogue and its verdict contradicts what the group decided.

regel: line 594 "Previous text of this scene, to be revised:" -- the placeholder is sent to the model (same in 30 line 714, 31 line 715, 32 line 627)
vorschlag: Either fill in the real previous scene text or drop the whole 'Previous text of this scene, to be revised:' block when there is none; never send the literal token [MITSCHNITT] as the text to be revised.
